question: In recognition of Governor Dumas's brave defense of Pondicherry against the Marathas and his protection of the Nawab's family, the Mughal Emperor conferred upon him:
options: The Title of Maharaja and the Zamindari of Tanjore
The Title of Nawab, the rank (mansab) of 4,500 horse, and the dignity of the umbrella
The Diwani rights of the Northern Circars
The title of 'Amir-ul-Umara' and the jagir of Masulipatnam
explanation: Safdar Ali Khan (the new Nawab of Arcot) and the Mughal Emperor (Muhammad Shah) were so impressed by Dumas's stand against the Marathas in 1740-41 that the Mughal Emperor conferred upon him the title of Nawab, a mansab of 4,500 horse, and the high honor of the dignity of the umbrella. This title was later passed on to his successor, Dupleix.
